div.div:
Step Functions — blog-pipeline-review
LoadDraft → ReviewFanOut (Map, ×4 providers)
→ Gate → PersistIteration → Decide
• loop → Redraft → ReviewFanOut
• pass / capped / quorum / exception → SetOutcome
(deterministic gate, max 4 iterations)
